name: HUNGERWINTER
source:
IT IS THE WORST WINTER ON RECORD. FAMINE GRIPS THE CONTINENT.

Join Ida Guggenhofer and Rosa Huber as they meet their friends, meet their foes and explore the city they hope to save.

[From [url=https://das-kunstkollektiv.itch.io/hungerwinter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是有记录以来最糟糕的冬天。饥荒席卷整个大陆。

加入艾达·古根霍夫和罗莎·胡伯的行列，与他们的朋友、敌人会面，并探索他们希望拯救的城市。

[来自[url=https://das-kunstkollektiv.itch.io/hungerwinter]itch.io[/url]]
